label: PHASE_9Q_DISCOVERY_BLOCKED_AFTER_CONVERSION
root_causes: BoundedScoutAssigner rebuilds a throwaway ExplorationState on every reassignment, so stall recovery and failed_targets never persist; scouts re-lock the same fog pocket for hundreds of turns (e.g. last_newly_scouted_turn=756 with scout_stall=443).
NO_CONTACT_DRAW games often reach dominant land (~0.86) with 100+ candidate general cells still unresolved — enemy isolated behind uncleared fog.
FOG_NOT_CLEARED games contact then stall scouting; terminal frames can show EMERGENCY_DEFENCE aborting scout.
Attempted dual-scout / expand-demotion / hard failed_targets fixes improved some no-discovery games (~5/27) but regressed conversion micro below 10/10; reverted to conversion-frozen scout.
next_incomplete_gate: DEVELOPMENT_GATE (discovery >= 0.60 while keeping conversion micro >= 0.80 and post-discovery >= 0.80)
exact_next_action: Implement persistent ExplorationState on policy state with soft region_attempts only (no permanent cell blacklist, no early expand demotion); dual-scout only after turn>=1050 AND stall>=40; gate each change with conversion micro 10/10 before discovery micro.
